pages.text: A working hookah needs $(item)fuel$(), $(item)Shisha Tobacco$(), and a vanilla $(item)Water Potion/Water Bottle$() in its three GUI slots. Slot validation prevents unrelated items from being inserted.

Hookah slots:$(br2)$(thing)Left/fuel:$() Bamboo Charcoal, Charcoal, or Coal$(br)$(thing)Shisha:$() Shisha Tobacco only$(br)$(thing)Water:$() a vanilla Potion item containing Water$(br2)The water bottle is not consumed by the current hookah process.
pages.title: Loading

pages.text: When all requirements are present and fuel time remains, the hookah lights and the shisha's durability begins to drain. While the hookah is active, hold a $(item)Hookah Hose$() in either hand and right-click the hookah to draw smoke.
pages.title: Smoking the Hookah

pages.text: Hookah-hose draws currently provide the hookah smoke interaction itself; they do not run the same nicotine/quality-effect routine as smoking a cigar, cigarette, or packed pipe. This is normal for the current hookah implementation.
pages.title: Effect Difference
